inbox.subject: Finance review due Tuesday night
inbox.body:
Alex,

Quick heads up for the week. I need your comments on the Q4 finance review by Tuesday night so I can lock the board financials Wednesday morning.

Headlines: ARR at $18.0M. October hiring came in at 6 starts versus 9 in September, so Q4 opex is tracking about $210K under plan. Harborline Mutual would add $2.9M ARR at $6 PEPM if we close this week.

Model and memo are in the board folder. Let's use our 1pm today to walk it.

Julian

inbox.subject: Q4 ops impacts and hiring slowdown
inbox.body:
Alex,

Ops side for Julian's review. We closed October at 150 heads with 48 care leads. Hiring slowed last month (6 starts, 4 of them care ops), and two care lead offers were declined.

The Harborline math is the pressure point: 1,600 households entering setup in January on a full launch, and we can set up 800 from January 1 and keep the promise. I'd like us to discuss a phased start before Friday.

I'll have the capacity sheet ready for the 1pm.

Jordan

inbox.subject: Harborline: they want an answer on rollout shape this week
inbox.body:
Morning Alex,

Marcus Feld, VP Benefits at Harborline Mutual, emailed Saturday. Their open enrollment comms go to print November 18, so they need our rollout shape by Friday, November 13. They still want a January 1 start for all 40,000 employees.

Pricing assumes 4% activation; we reprice at renewal if it crosses 6%. I'll bring both full and phased options to 10:30am.

Tomás

inbox.subject: Donna's plan this week, two items not confirmed
inbox.body:
Hi Alex,

Your mom's plan for this week isn't locked yet. Two open items:

1. Pedicure Thursday, November 12 at 11am at Willow Lane Nail Studio. They haven't confirmed a tech who does diabetic foot care, and I'd rather not send her without that. I'm also still booking the ride.
2. Specialty grocery run Saturday, November 14 at 10am at Greenhollow Market for her low-sodium items. Tommy will cover since I'm off that day, but the store hasn't confirmed the order is in.

I'll keep chasing both. Can we talk at 4:30?

Erika

inbox.subject: Board meeting Nov 20 logistics
inbox.body:
Alex,

Confirming I'll be in person for the board meeting next Friday, November 20 at 9am. Could the deck come out by Monday/Tuesday? I'd like time to read the Harborline section closely.

Best,
Helen

inbox.subject: Lena Okafor final round packet

Grace
